historical_source_excerpts: The included Phase19 theorem/next-gate text, Phase20 theorem/audit, corrected selector and predecessor programs support source-relative comparison. Their own imports are historical provenance, not dependencies of the new executor or controls. No historical execution closure is claimed.
external_comparison_boundary: The inherited comparison report and acceptance are included. Previously inspected external paper PDFs and the complete original archives are not bundled and are not runtime or proof inputs for the elementary new refinement; no new literature review or priority clearance is claimed.
administrative_capture_runtime_role: None; omitted capture is never read by the four new research programs.
recorded_runtime: Python 3.12 (from source execution artifacts); standard-library-only programs. Python 3.8+ supports modular inverses used by these scripts; use Python 3.12 for closest recorded environment.
replay_paths: Keep candidate/ and review/ as siblings. Pass candidate explicitly to review/independent_controls.py; its historical default sibling directory name is not the publication layout.
immutable_evidence: Replays write results into disposable extracted directories. Preserve the downloaded archive and original manifests as evidence.
packaging_execution: Package construction and verify_package.py check only bytes, JSON, CRCs, static import declarations and dependency references; they do not execute scientific programs.
